2 Inline Math After Text Render Gate
Construct A: control – top-level paragraph (already works today; this shape must stay byte-identical, 
it is a regression guard, not a defect reproduction).
With space before math: 𝐸 = 𝑚𝑐2 after.

Construct C: collapsed field bodies – the concat context. The ​:type​: value is the sole inline math 
(math as the FIRST expression in the concat context, no leading separator). The ​:default​: value is 
prose then math (math following a sibling, exactly one separator).
math_inline_default
Type: 𝑥  Default: The value of 𝑥 computed inline
A description paragraph so the confval also exercises the block field-body and normal-
paragraph path.

(MATH-02). With no following sibling inside the item, there is nothing for the trailing separator flag 
to affect, so this construct’s emission must be identical before and after the MATH-02 fix.
